description: Monthly IDR salary benchmark (median, p25, p75, sample size) per role x seniority cell over the last 90 days; cells under the minimum sample are suppressed. Without a key or with a free key you get the free layer (largest-sample cells only); a key with paid market access gets every cell. Same data as GET /api/v1/market/salary. Every result carries free_layer and paid_depth_url (free layer also dataset_depth_url).
name: get_salary_benchmark
title: Get salary benchmark
